content.value: In a jet propulsion unit, air at 1 bar and $3 \%$ is compressed in an uncooled compressor to a pressure of 3.5 bar where $\eta _ { c } = 8 2 \%$ . The air is then led to combustion chamber where fuel is burnt and products of combustion at $5 0 0 \%$ pass through a turbine with $\eta _ { c } = 8 4 \%$ . The exhaust gases from the turbine are further expanded in a nozzle down to 0.8 bar, the nozzle efficiency being 90%. Calculate - (i) power required to run the compressor, (ii) air fuel ratio, the fuel used has a heating value of 38 MJ/kg and heater loss is 10% of heating value, (iii) pressure of gases leaving the turbine. Take the initial velocity of aircraft as 200 m/s, $c _ { p } = 1 . 0 0 5 \mathrm { k J / k g . K }$ and $\gamma = 1 . 4$ both for air and gases.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
